work_budget_note: Agent-hour estimates are rough independent work budgets, not elapsed-time promises. Core is a priority pool, not an all-or-nothing release scope. No padding, repeated passing tests or waiting to meet a duration target.
runtime_scheduling: Honor depends_on; conditionally_recheck_after invalidates QA only when that package is included and changed after the check. Shared-file ownership and build locks are separate serial constraints. Actual declared input fingerprints always govern evidence invalidation; conditional package lists are non-exhaustive reminders, never allowlists permitting reuse after unlisted changes. Freeze feature intake at the planned end minus 4–5 hours; a 12-hour window enters final QA at hour 7–8.

baseline.working_tree: active concurrent uncommitted implementation; must be resampled before execution
